text.headings.ts: Lists a Markdown file's headings with the same ids the page gives them, for the sidebar contents and the link check
text.links.ts: Turns a link in the Markdown into a site route, an image, an external link or a repository-only file, and reads and writes hash routes
text.pages.ts: Declares which repository Markdown files are pages of the docs site, with their routes, labels and the site title
text.sheets.ts: Numbers the docs pages and finds the previous and next page
text.sources.ts: Bundles the page Markdown and the logo images from the repository at build time
text.tags.ts: Removes the HTML tags from a piece of heading markup by scanning for angle brackets, keeping a lone less-than sign and an empty pair of brackets
text.useHash.ts: Gives a component the current URL hash and re-renders it when the hash changes
